description: Distribute ETH from a source wallet to multiple destination wallets. Useful for funding a wallet pool before coordinated operations.

amount_each.description: Amount of ETH to send to each wallet (e.g. '0.001')

api_key.description: Premium API key for unlimited access. Free tier: 5/hour.

confirm.description: Must be true to execute. Set false to simulate first.

from_address.description: Source wallet address (must be a managed wallet or the deployer)

to_addresses.description: Specific destination addresses. If omitted, distributes to ALL managed wallets.

name: wallet_distribute_eth
